events.evidence: A Saudi-led coalition airstrike on a market in Sahar District in Yemen's northern Saada Governorate, which is under Houthi control, kills at least 26 people
Two fuel tankers are bombed in the Afghan town of Charikar, killing at least 15 people
A gunman opens fire in a Walmart in Thornton, Colorado, killing three people
